title: RoyalMC SMP Modpack
description: RoyalMC SMP Modpack is an modpack that has sparks of QOL and FPS
body: **![RoyalMC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fca8252337a02e9c77b2bdb68d28299bcc2c35b.png)** **INFO:** This pack aims to maintain the original Minecraft experience while also providing optimization, quality of life and a bit of an sweet touch! This modpack is for fabric and will always be updated for the latest version! Ask questions in our discord, goodluck and have an nice experience! The mods provide optimisation in ways of FPS and Quality of Life, also they add many features like an better sun, fog, clouds, sound improvements and many more, come and find out by downloading the modpack at versions!
